executive_summary: Maven build failed with 100 compilation errors across test files. Primary issues include missing service methods (getColumnStats, bulkUpdateColumnCounts, getTaskDetails), type incompatibilities between String and Long for IDs, and enum type mismatches between DTOs. These errors indicate incomplete implementation of service interfaces and misaligned data types between test expectations and actual implementations.

errors.root_cause: ColumnService interface does not define getColumnStats(String) method that tests are calling
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getColumnStats(String columnId) method to ColumnService interface and implement it in ColumnServiceImpl

errors.root_cause: ColumnService interface does not define bulkUpdateColumnCounts method that tests are calling
errors.fix_recommendation: Add bulkUpdateColumnCounts(BulkUpdateColumnCountsRequest) method to ColumnService interface and implement it in ColumnServiceImpl

errors.message: Incompatible types: inference variable T has incompatible bounds (upper: Long, lower: String)
errors.root_cause: Test is passing String where Long is expected for task ID parameter
errors.fix_recommendation: Update test to use Long.valueOf() or change task ID from String to Long in test setup

errors.message: Incompatible types: String cannot be converted to Long
errors.root_cause: Task ID is defined as Long in entity but test is using String
errors.fix_recommendation: Change task ID from String to Long in TaskDetailsResponse or update entity to use String consistently

errors.message: Incompatible types: TaskStatus cannot be converted to String
errors.root_cause: TaskStatus is an enum but being assigned to String field in response DTO
errors.fix_recommendation: Change status field in TaskDetailsResponse from String to TaskStatus enum or convert enum to String using .name()

errors.root_cause: TaskDetailsResponse DTO does not have setColumnId method
errors.fix_recommendation: Add columnId field with getter/setter to TaskDetailsResponse DTO or use builder pattern

errors.root_cause: TaskService interface does not define getTaskDetails(String) method
errors.fix_recommendation: Add getTaskDetails(Long taskId) method to TaskService interface and implement it in TaskServiceImpl

errors.message: Incompatible types: TaskPriority cannot be converted to TaskCreateRequest.TaskPriority
errors.root_cause: TaskPriority enum exists in two places causing type mismatch
errors.fix_recommendation: Use single TaskPriority enum definition or ensure TaskCreateRequest uses the shared enum type

errors.root_cause: TaskResponse DTO does not have setVersion method
errors.fix_recommendation: Add version field with getter/setter to TaskResponse DTO for optimistic locking support

errors.root_cause: PagedTaskResponse DTO does not have setLast method for pagination metadata
errors.fix_recommendation: Add last field with getter/setter to PagedTaskResponse DTO to indicate if this is the last page

errors.message: Method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types (required: Long,int,int; found: Long,int,int,String)
errors.root_cause: getUserTasks method signature mismatch - test passing 4 parameters but method expects 3
errors.fix_recommendation: Update getUserTasks method signature to accept status filter parameter or remove status parameter from test calls

errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler does not have handleConcurrentCreation method
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @ExceptionHandler method handleConcurrentCreation in GlobalExceptionHandler to handle ConcurrentTaskCreationException

summary: 12 grouped compilation errors found across test files
